summary: Iter200 — Accounts Payment Processing Center: Reject Payment + Filters + Rejected tab verified end-to-end.  Backend pytest 10/10 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter200_reject_payment.py).  Covered: (a) happy path POST /api/accounts/payment-queue/{rid}/reject-payment on a verified row → returns stage='rejected', rejection_reason, rejected_from_stage='verified', rejected_by, rejected_at; project_requests row mirrors payment_status='rejected' + payment_rejection_reason; NO journal entry with source_event='rejected' created; (b) mandatory reason: missing body / '' / whitespace / 'ab' all → 400 'Rejection reason is mandatory'; (c) unknown rid → 404 'Verification record not found'; (d) pending_verification row → 400 (no verification record); (e) already-paid row → 400 'already paid — it cannot be rejected'; (f) RBAC: safety_officer POST → 403 Forbidden; (g) re-verify after reject restores stage='verified'; (h) cleanup by re-verifying using the row's prior verification payload. Frontend verified on preview (super_admin, /app/accounts/payment-processing): KPI header now has 5 cards including ppc-kpi-rejected ('REJECTED 2'); ppc-filters bar is visible with ppc-filter-search / ppc-filter-status / ppc-filter-basis / ppc-filter-from / ppc-filter-to / ppc-filter-count (shows '41 of 41 payment(s)'); 5 tabs rendered (Pending 21, Verified/Bank File 1, Bank Files & Mark Paid 2, Paid History 15, Rejected 2); ppc-tab-rejected lists 2 rejected rows each with a ppc-reverify-btn-<req_no>; Bank Files & Mark Paid tab shows 2 rows each with Mark Paid AND a red 'Reject Payment' button (ppc-reject-payment-btn-REQ-2026-0063 / 0064); clicking opens ppc-reject-dialog where ppc-reject-submit is DISABLED with empty reason, DISABLED with 'ab' (<3 chars), and ENABLED with a 3+ char reason; setting ppc-filter-status='rejected' narrows ppc-filter-count to '2 of 41 payment(s)' while ppc-kpi-rejected stays at 2 (UNFILTERED totals confirmed); ppc-filter-search='ZZZ_NO_MATCH_XYZ' narrows to '0 of 41 payment(s)'; ppc-filter-clear resets back to '41 of 41 payment(s)'. No data mutation left behind (reject tests re-verify in cleanup).

minor.issue: A pending_verification row (no verification record) also returns 404 'Verification record not found' instead of a 400 explaining 'only a verified payment can be rejected'. Acceptable but 400 would read better and matches the task spec ('pending_verification payment → 400').

issues: ppc-filter-clear button is hidden when no filter is currently applied (visible=False on fresh load). This is a reasonable UX choice but means an automated test must set a filter first before asserting the clear button's presence. Not a bug.

action_items: (Minor spec deviation) In reject_payment(), when the project_requests row exists but has no payment_verifications doc (i.e. pending_verification stage), return 400 'Only a verified payment can be rejected' instead of 404 'Verification record not found'. Current behavior still blocks the action correctly but the HTTP code differs from the spec wording.
critical_code_review_comments: reject_payment() guards stage with `not in ('verified', 'in_bank_file')` — correct, but the 404 vs 400 fall-through for pending_verification rows (no verification doc at all) returns 404 which is semantically misleading (the request_id DOES exist in project_requests). Consider: look up project_requests first to decide 404 vs 400.

reject_payment() does NOT clear any bank-file linkage on an `in_bank_file` row — the BPF-xxxx file keeps the request_id in its payload. This matches the intent ('generated bank files are left untouched as audit artefacts') but downstream Mark Paid on the SAME bank file could re-encounter a rejected id; mark_paid()'s guard `v.get('stage') in ('verified','in_bank_file')` correctly blocks it with 400. Worth adding a unit test for the stale-bank-file edge case to lock the behaviour.

mark_paid() allows a payment in `in_bank_file` stage to move to paid without re-verifying; if the admin rejected it after bank-file generation, the row disappears from the Bank Files & Mark Paid tab (via pay_stage='rejected') but still appears inside the generated BPF-xxxx XLSX. This is a documentation/UX concern — recommend adding a 'reject invalidates bank-file inclusion' note next to the download button, OR regenerate the bank file on reject.

`PaymentProcessingCenter.jsx` is 1060 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Candidates to split: BulkUtrDialog is already extracted; consider splitting VerifyDialog, RejectDialog, FiltersBar, and QueueTable into their own files to simplify maintenance.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — KPI unfiltered totals + filter bar + Rejected tab + Reject button + reject dialog disabled/enabled states + status filter narrowing + search filter + clear filters all verified.

seed_data_creation: No new seed data was created. The 10 backend tests reject-then-reverify the first verified row they find and leave it in verified state (idempotent).  The 2 existing rejected rows and 2 in_bank_file rows in the preview DB were not mutated by the UI test (we only opened the dialog and pressed Escape).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter200_reject_payment.py is idempotent: every test that calls POST .../reject-payment re-verifies the same rid immediately after, using the row's own prior verification payload (keeps invoice_no / vendor fields intact).  The queue fixture is module-scoped so the 2 reject-based tests pick the same first verified row — if there is >1 verified row they still work.  Known data in preview: 21 pending_verification, 1 verified, 2 in_bank_file, 15 paid, 2 rejected.  Filter bar hides ppc-filter-clear until a filter is applied — tests must set a filter before asserting the Clear button is visible.
rca of the issue: N/A — enhancement verified. Reject-payment endpoint + mandatory-reason guard + stage transitions + RBAC + re-verify flow all working. Filter bar, Rejected tab, Rejected KPI, and reject dialog with disabled Confirm button until reason >=3 chars all working on the live preview.
